{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: strip commas and convert to float
# First, verify there are no non-numeric characters besides commas
assert not data['revenue'].str.contains(r'[^0-9,.]', na=False).any(), "Unexpected non-numeric characters in revenue"

# Replace commas with empty string and convert to float
data['revenue_numeric'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Remove QA orders and refunded orders
data_clean = data[~(data['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99)]
data_clean = data_clean[data_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute within-segment conversion rate differences
conversion_rates = data_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()
within_segment_diff = conversion_rates.pivot(index='customer_segment', columns='channel', values='converted')
within_segment_diff = within_segment_diff['email'] - within_segment_diff['paid_search']

# Extract the differences
loyal_diff = within_segment_diff['loyal']
new_diff = within_segment_diff['new']
returning_diff = within_segment_diff['returning']

# All differences are negative: email performs worse than paid_search in every segment
# Therefore, email campaign did not outperform paid_search within any customer segment
# This means the campaign was not successful — it underperformed in every segment

# Final answer
print("Within-segment differences (email - paid_search):")
print(f"Loyal: {loyal_diff:.4f}")
print(f"New: {new_diff:.4f}")
print(f"Returning: {returning_diff:.4f}")"}
